title: Access RMS web application (via Argus server) and verify the overview screen
summary: Use the site Argus server information and the site-specific unique IP to open the RMS web application, log in with the RMS username/password, and confirm the RMS overview screen loads.
when_to_use: When you need to access the RMS web application for a site and confirm that, after login, the user lands on the RMS overview screen.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Access the site Argus server/RMS web location using the site unique IP, log into the RMS web application, and verify the RMS overview screen loads.

access_required: Browser access to the RMS web location using the site unique IP address
system_preconditions: You have the site Argus server information needed to determine the RMS web location

visual_references.description: Frame showing the RMS web application access concept and the statement that after login you will see the RMS overview screen (top-left indicator mentioned).

steps.title: Identify the site Argus server and the RMS web location (RMS service) address, including the unique IP address for the site
steps.purpose: Ensure you use the correct site-specific RMS web location so the login and overview screen check are performed against the intended site.
steps.instruction: From the site access information you have, identify the Argus server for the site and the RMS web location address that uses the site unique IP to access the RMS service.
steps.expected_result: You have the site unique IP address (RMS web location) available to enter into a browser.
steps.healthy_condition: The unique IP you plan to use corresponds to the intended site’s RMS service (via the site Argus server).
steps.failure_condition: You do not have the correct site unique IP / RMS web location for the site, or you cannot determine it from the provided site access information.

actions.label: Confirm Argus server and unique IP for the site
actions.exact_action: Identify the site Argus server and the RMS web location (RMS service) address, including the unique IP address for the site.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: For each site, you have an Argus server and you access the RMS web location using a unique IP address to access this RMS service.

steps.title: Open the RMS web application using the unique IP address in a browser
steps.purpose: Reach the RMS web application landing page for the site so you can log in.
steps.instruction: In a browser, open the RMS web application by entering the site unique IP address for the RMS service.
steps.expected_result: The RMS web application page loads in the browser (ready for username/password entry).
steps.healthy_condition: The RMS web application is reachable at the entered unique IP address.
steps.failure_condition: The RMS web application does not load/reaches a blank page when the firewall is not open (as described in the training).

actions.label: Navigate to RMS web location via unique IP
actions.exact_action: Open the RMS web application using the unique IP address in a browser.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the RMS web page does not load (e.g., blank page due to firewall not open), stop and escalate for support.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: “This page should show RMS, but the firewall is not open, so it just kind of shows blank.”
You access the RMS web location using a unique IP address to access this RMS service.

steps.title: Enter the username and password for RMS
steps.purpose: Authenticate to the RMS web application so you can reach the overview screen.
steps.instruction: On the RMS web application login page, enter the RMS username and password and submit to log in.
steps.expected_result: Login succeeds and the RMS overview screen is displayed.
steps.healthy_condition: After submitting credentials, the application proceeds to the overview screen.
steps.failure_condition: Login fails and you cannot proceed to the overview screen.

actions.label: Log into RMS web application
actions.exact_action: Enter the username and password for RMS.

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: Once you access that address, you put in the username and password… And this is what you will see. This is the overview screen.

steps.title: Verify the RMS overview screen loads
steps.purpose: Confirm the correct post-login landing page so you can proceed with troubleshooting/diagnostics from the RMS UI.
steps.instruction: After login, verify that the RMS overview screen is displayed. Confirm the overview screen appearance as shown in the provided reference frame (including the top-left indicator mentioned in the segment).
steps.expected_result: The RMS overview screen is displayed after login.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the RMS overview screen (the segment notes it “kinda gives you on the top left corner a little”).
steps.failure_condition: The RMS overview screen does not load after login.

actions.label: Check for RMS overview screen after login
actions.exact_action: Verify the RMS overview screen loads.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the RMS overview screen does not load after login, stop and escalate for support (the segment frames this as the first place to pinpoint the problem via the RMS web page).

source_evidence.quote_or_paraphrase: “And this is what you will see. This is the overview screen… It kinda gives you on the top left corner a little.”
The segment describes that once you access the address and log in, you will see the overview screen.

success_criteria: RMS web application opens successfully using the site unique IP address.
After entering username and password, the RMS overview screen is displayed.
healthy_conditions: RMS overview screen is visible after login (including the small top-left indicator mentioned in the segment).
failure_conditions: RMS web page shows blank due to firewall not open.
RMS overview screen does not load after login.
escalation_guidance: If the RMS overview screen does not load after login, stop and escalate for support to pinpoint the problem via the RMS web page.

screens_or_images.description: Reference frame for the RMS overview screen concept and top-left indicator mentioned in the segment.
